newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to present new 1996/97 sugar balance Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: EU to present new 1996/97 sugar balance Wednesday.

text.p: The latest official sugar balance sheet forecast for the 1996/97 (July/June) crop year will be presented to European Union experts on Wednesday, an EU official said on Monday.
"The latest production forecast will be given to the sugar management committee by the Commisson but we are still some time away from a final figure," the official said.
In its last forecast on October 17 the Commission put beet sugar production at 15.63 million tonnes in 1996/97 compared with 15.64 million tonnes last season.

The latest balance sheet is likely to show an increase in this year's total due to favourable weather conditions, Jules Beauduin, secretary general of the European Committee of Sugar Manufacturers, told Reuters.
"We anticipate that the harvest will be much better than expeected. It is impossible to say by how much but the final figure should be above last year's figure," he said.
